siMeaning: Super Intelligence (SI): AI tools including code assistants, generative image/video tools and synthetic speech.

code.description: The project includes SI-generated and SI-assisted code reviewed and iterated during development. Gameplay does not call an open-ended LLM.

fictionalGameContent.description: Mission text, resource costs, rewards, thresholds and teaching scenarios include SI assistance. They are invented game abstractions, not NASA measurements.

externalScientificSources.description: NASA/CSA science references and retrieved NASA API observations retain their original attribution. SI assistance with explanations does not make those source observations SI-generated.
externalScientificSources.references: production/submission/SUBMISSION.md and the in-game Sources & SI use screen

media.description: Original station background, main-menu background and mission logo. Team confirmed all three were AI-generated on 2026-11-15. Do not infer a specific model or provider.
media.disclosure: Visible SI-generated watermark in each image and readable scene/menu labels.

media.description: Fictional game plants and base lighting/damage edits; not NASA imagery or measured crop conditions.
media.disclosure: Visible SI-generated watermark embedded in each distributed image; readable in-game scene/experiment labels cover cropped or scaled displays.

media.description: Opening landing video. The original file identifies Kling in its AIGC generation metadata.
media.disclosure: SI-generated watermark throughout the file, retained AIGC metadata, and an in-player SI-generated video label that remains readable when mobile cover cropping hides the file label.

media.description: SI-generated Rocky (M2) and Mission Control (F2) narration, prepared offline. No human voice cloning.
media.disclosure: Credits text, embedded MP3 ID3 disclosure, and generation metadata in assets/voice/manifest.json.

branding.description: Generated content uses fictional Astro Base artwork. The separate inherited Space Apps logo is not included in generated media or altered by the disclosure changes.
branding.visualReview: Eight generated variants, the three original images, and a 4 fps contact sheet covering the full 5.04-second intro were checked for apparent NASA logos, flags or mission identifiers. See local review report for evidence and limits; this is not legal certification.
